name: DrawPass
signature: public sealed class DrawPass : Component, IRenderSync

docs.summary: Draws every visible renderer's shader pass tagged "LightMode" = [`PassType`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.PassType) in every camera of the scene, such as "Outline". Each pass draws with the render state its shader gives it, so outlines, silhouettes seen through walls and similar effects need only the pass in their shaders.
The "LightMode" tag of the shader passes to draw.
Draw passes in the same stage draw lowest first.
